english: The children liked the sweet mangoes.
paite: Hai min naupangte'n lim asa uh.
explanation: Sweet mango kha hai amin chiang a a khum na gen ahi

english: The children visit their old aunt.
paite: Naupangte'n a nuneu uh upa mahmahta a va veh uh.

english: He borrows a pencil from his friend.
paite: Ama'n a lawmpa pencil a khel/zatsak.

english: The girl brushes her long hair.
paite: Numei naupang in a samsau ahiat.

english: He pushes the small cart.
paite: Ama'n kangtalai (leng) neupen a sawn.

english: My clothes dried after the rain.
paite: Ka puante vuah theu in akeu.
also_correct: Vuah zukkhit ka puante a keuta

variants.paite: Vuah zukkhit ka puante a keuta

english: Summer rain feels warm on the skin.
paite: Nipi vuah in i chi hon den khak a lum hithit.
also_correct: Nipi vuah tui in i taksa a hetkhak chiangin a lum

variants.paite: Nipi vuah tui in i taksa a hetkhak chiangin a lum

explanation: literal tak a i lehdek chiang in eipau ah lemlou a bang

english: My wife likes the small cat.
paite: Ka zi'n meng/zohngeu neute a deih.
also_correct: Ka zi in zohngeu neu(pen) a deih

variants.paite: Ka zi in zohngeu neu(pen) a deih

english: The pastor helps the poor.
paite: Pastorpa'n mi gentheite a panpih.

english: Few people live on the mountain.
paite: Tang/Mualtung ah mi tamlou a teng uh/khosa uh.
also_correct: Mualtung ah mi tawmchik a teng uh

variants.paite: Mualtung ah mi tawmchik a teng uh

english: The cat sits on the wall.
paite: Huai meng dai ah a tu.

english: My poor neighbour has five children.
paite: Khosak haksa sa ka innvengpa'n/nu'n ta nga a nei.
also_correct: Ka inn veng/pam te'n ta nga a nei uh

variants.paite: Ka inn veng/pam te'n ta nga a nei uh

english: The husband and wife walk home.
paite: Nupate khe in inn apai uh.

english: My shoes are black and old.
paite: A khedapte vom in lui lua.
also_correct: Ka khedap vom in a luita

variants.paite: Ka khedap vom in a luita

english: Her bag is yellow and light.
paite: A kawlzal a eng leh a zang hi.
also_correct: A ip a eng in a zang hi

variants.paite: A ip a eng in a zang hi

english: He works alone in the field.
paite: Amah kia in lou ah na a sem.
also_correct: Amah in lou ah na a sem

variants.paite: Amah in lou ah na a sem

english: The black night is cold and still.
paite: Zankhomial dai in dam e.
also_correct: Zanmial a vot in a dai hi

variants.paite: Zanmial a vot in a dai hi

english: She reads alone in the small room.
paite: Ama'n pindan neu sungah lai a sim.
also_correct: Pindan neu sung ah minu in amah kia in lai a sim

variants.paite: Pindan neu sung ah minu in amah kia in lai a sim

english: He sits alone and drinks his tea.
paite: Amah kia a tu in singpi a dawn.
also_correct: Amah a tu in singpi a don.

variants.paite: Amah a tu in singpi a don.

explanation: Mipa amah kia tu in singpi a dawn hi

english: I wear a shirt every day.
paite: Niteng in puanak angkilhnei ka silh gige.

english: The shop had many people.
paite: Dawr ah mi tampi aom uh.

english: The village road leads to the town.
paite: Hiai khawta lampi in khawpi hon tun.

english: Who is this boy/man/guy?
paite: Huai pa kua a?

english: He pours breast milk into the cup.
paite: Pasal khat in nou sung ah Nawitui a sung
original_english: He poured milk into a cup.
explanation: One pour a breast milk inside the cup.

english: Fire keeps the food warm.
paite: Mei in ann a hailum. Or, Mei in ann a koih lum. Or Mei in ann a su lum.
original_english: The fire kept the food warm.

english: We walk home slowly after the feast.
paite: Annekkham in awl in khe in inlam ka pai uh.

english: Everyone hopes for another happy festival next year.
paite: Miteng in kumnawn chia'h hunnuam zat kilamen nawn hi.

english: She bought a new shirt yesterday.
paite: Ama'n puan-ak zan in a lei.
explanation: A van di, a ki zep ne ding poimoh ahih man in a van ding lei hi.

english: He opened the internet page slowly.
paite: Ama'n internet awl in a hong.

english: The village people are kind and friendly.
paite: Khomite ching in a polhnuam uh.

english: Our team practices every evening.
paite: Nitaklam teng in kou team te ka kizil zel uh

english: He swam across the lake.
paite: Aman hiai dil liau kai hi.
explanation: A person swim the lake from one saide to the other.

english: I washed the dishes after cooking.
paite: Ann ka huan khit in bel ka hahsiang
original_english: I cleaned the pot after cooking.

english: We sit and have a chitchat in the afternoon.
paite: Nitaklam in tukhawm in ka houlim uh
original_english: We sit and talk in the evening.

english: We walk towards the shop by the road.
paite: Lamkiang a dawr zuan in ka pai uh.
original_english: We walked to the corner shop.

english: The teacher is patient.
paite: Sinsaktu a zaidam.

english: The doctor looked at my throat.
paite: Doctor in ka gawl hon etsak.

english: There is an institution in this village.
paite: Hiai khua ah siamsin na khat a om
original_english: The village has one small school.

english: He paid the driver and got out.
paite: Gari khalhpa/hekpa sum pia in, gari apat a kum.

english: She smiled at the small children.
paite: Ama'n naupang neute en in anui.

english: We look forward to the next festival.
paite: Nunnop bawl hong tungnawn pah leh kachi uh.
explanation: Nunnop bawl hong tungnawn ding ka ngaklah uh

english: My friend prayed for me.
paite: Ka lawm in hon thumsak.

english: He wants to buy a new hat.
paite: Ama'n lukhu thak a lei ut.

english: He fixes the fence with wood.
paite: Ama'n sing zang in daivangte ahu.
explanation: Sing zang in dai a bawlhoih

english: He sharpens his tool before work.
paite: A nasepma in a vanzatte atat hiam.

english: He broke his hand last year.
paite: Nikum in a khut a sutan
original_english: He broke his arm last year.

english: We finish the festival with a feast.
paite: Nopbawlna ann nek in ka zou uh
original_english: The festival ends with a big meal.

english: They take baths at the lake in the summer.
paite: Dil ah mipi lai in a kibual uh.
original_english: They swim in the lake during summer.

english: He/she slowly lifts up his/her left hand.
paite: A khut veilam awl in a liktou.
original_english: He raised his left shoulder slowly.
